issues.detail: Hebrew 'וְנָתַן עָלַיִךְ דָּיֵק' means 'he will set a siege wall against you' (דָּיֵק = siege wall/rampart), but Chinese renders '他必使勇士攻擊你' ('he will make warriors attack you'), introducing '勇士' (warriors) not in the Hebrew and changing the meaning from a siege structure to an attack by warriors.
